## Load data
```{r load-data, warning = FALSE}
Data <- read.csv("Data.csv") %>%
        dplyr::select(-Strand) %>%
        filter(Gene != "βLCR") %>%
        filter(Gene != "HS40") %>%
        distinct()
```

## Load ClinVar variants
```{r load-clinvar}
Chromosome <- c(11, 11, 11, 16, 16, 16, 11, 11, 11, 16)
Start <- c(5225464, 5232838, 5248269, 152644, 172876, 176680, 5253188, 5268345, 5270791, 106756)
End   <- c(5227071, 5234483, 5249857, 154503, 173710, 177522, 5254781, 5269945, 5292315, 116059)

ClinVar <- list()

for (x in seq_along(Chromosome)) {Query <- readVcf("ClinVar/clinvar.vcf.gz", 
                                                   genome = "hg38", 
                                                   param = GRanges(seqnames = Chromosome[x],
                                                                   ranges = IRanges(start = Start[x], 
                                                                                    end = End[x])))
                                  Variants <- as.data.frame(rowRanges(Query))  
                                  
                                  Variants <- Variants[rep(seq_len(nrow(Variants)), elementNROWS(alt(Query))), ]
                                  Variants$Alt <- unlist(lapply(alt(Query), as.character), use.names = FALSE)
                                  
                                  ReviewStatus <- info(Query)$CLNREVSTAT
                                  
                                  ReviewStatus <- lapply(ReviewStatus,
                                                         function(x) paste(unique(as.character(x)), collapse = ";"))
ReviewStatus <- unlist(ReviewStatus, use.names = FALSE)
                                  
                                  Variants <- Variants %>%
                                              mutate(Chromosome = Chromosome[x],
                                                     Start = as.numeric(start),
                                                     Ref = as.character(REF),
                                                     End = as.numeric(Start) + (str_count(Ref, "[A-Za-z]") - 1),
                                                     ClinVar = unlist(info(Query)$CLNSIG, use.names = FALSE),
                                                     ReviewStatus = ReviewStatus) %>%
                                              mutate(Gene = ifelse(Start >= 5225464 & End <= 5227071 & Chromosome == 11, "HBB",
                                                            ifelse(Start >= 5232838 & End <= 5234483 & Chromosome == 11, "HBD",
                                                            ifelse(Start >= 5248269 & End <= 5249857 & Chromosome == 11, "HBG1",
                                                            ifelse(Start >= 152644 & End <= 154503 & Chromosome == 16, "HBZ",
                                                            ifelse(Start >= 172876 & End <= 173710 & Chromosome == 16, "HBA2",
                                                            ifelse(Start >= 176680 & End <= 177522 & Chromosome == 16, "HBA1",
                                                            ifelse(Start >= 5253188 & End <= 5254781 & Chromosome == 11, "HBG2",
                                                            ifelse(Start >= 5268345 & End <= 5269945 & Chromosome == 11, "HBE1", NA))))))))) %>%
                                              dplyr::select(Chromosome, Gene, Start, End, Ref, Alt, ClinVar, ReviewStatus) %>%
                                              filter(!is.na(Gene)) 
                                  
                                  ClinVar[[length(ClinVar) + 1]] <- Variants}

ClinVar <- do.call(rbind, ClinVar) %>%
           distinct() %>%
           mutate(Stars = ifelse(ReviewStatus == "criteria_provided;_multiple_submitters;_no_conflicts", 2, 
                          ifelse(ReviewStatus == "criteria_provided;_conflicting_classifications", 1,
                          ifelse(ReviewStatus == "criteria_provided;_single_submitter", 1,
                          ifelse(ReviewStatus == "no_classification_for_the_single_variant", 0,
                          ifelse(ReviewStatus == "no_assertion_criteria_provided", 0,
                          ifelse(ReviewStatus == "no_classification_provided", 0, NA))))))) %>%
           dplyr::select(-ReviewStatus)

rm(Chromosome, Start, End, Query, Variants, x)
```

### Add ClinVar IDs to GnomAD variants
```{r clinvar-id, warning = FALSE}
Data <- Data %>% 
        filter(Gene != "Non-target genes or intergenic regions") %>%
        left_join(ClinVar, by = c("Chromosome", "Gene", "Start", "End", "Ref", "Alt")) %>% 
        distinct() %>%
        relocate(ClinVar, Stars, .after = Alt)
```

### Determine variants unique to ClinVar [comparison to gnomADv4.1 Joint]
```{r clinvar-unique}
ClinVar <- ClinVar %>%
           mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, End, Ref, Alt, sep = "_")) %>%
           filter(!(ID %in% unique((Data %>%
                                    mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, End, Ref, Alt, sep = "_")) %>%
                                    filter(Version == "GnomADv4.1" & Region == "Joint"))$ID))) %>%
           mutate(Version = "GnomADv4.1",
                  Region = "Joint") %>%
           dplyr::select(Version, Region, Chromosome, Gene, Start, End, Ref, Alt, ClinVar, Stars)

nrow(ClinVar)
```

## Load visualization configurations
```{r config}
#font_import(pattern = "arial")
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(loadfonts()))

ggthemr("dust", spacing = 2, layout = "scientific")

LeftGutter <- function(p) {g <- ggplotGrob(p) 
                           panel_idx <- grep("^panel", g$layout$name)
                           stopifnot(length(panel_idx) > 0)
                           panel_l <- min(g$layout$l[panel_idx])
                           sum(g$widths[seq_len(panel_l - 1)])}

LeftPadding <- function(p, target) {g <- ggplotGrob(p)
                                    panel_idx <- grep("^panel", g$layout$name)
                                    stopifnot(length(panel_idx) > 0)
                                    panel_l <- min(g$layout$l[panel_idx])
                                    cur <- sum(g$widths[seq_len(panel_l - 1)])
                                    diff <- target - cur
                                    if (convertWidth(diff, "mm", valueOnly = TRUE) > 0) {g$widths[1] <- g$widths[1] + diff}
                                    wrap_elements(full = g)}
```

## Load gene locations
```{r gene-info}
if(file.exists("genes.sqlite"))
  {genes <- AnnotationDbi::loadDb("genes.sqlite")} else 
  {genes <- GenomicFeatures::makeTxDbFromEnsembl(port = 3306,
                                                 release = 111,
                                                 circ_seqs = NULL,
                                                 password = NULL,
                                                 username = "anonymous",
                                                 organism = "Homo sapiens",
                                                 tx_attrib = "gencode_basic",
                                                 server = "ensembldb.ensembl.org")
  
  AnnotationDbi::saveDb(genes, file = "genes.sqlite")

  genes_info <- as.list(genes)

  genes_info$transcripts <- as.data.frame((as_tibble(genes_info$transcripts) %>%
                            dplyr::filter(tx_name %in% c("ENST00000252951", "ENST00000251595",
                                                         "ENST00000336906", "ENST00000320868", "ENST00000396895",
                                                         "ENST00000330597", "ENST00000650601", "ENST00000335295"))))
                        
  genes_info$splicings <- as.data.frame((as_tibble(genes_info$splicings) %>%
                          dplyr::filter(tx_id %in% (genes_info$transcripts %>% as_tibble() %>% .[['tx_id']]))))
  
  genes_info$genes <- as.data.frame((as_tibble(genes_info$genes) %>%
                      dplyr::filter(tx_id %in% (genes_info$transcripts %>% as_tibble() %>% .[['tx_id']]))))

  genes_info$chrominfo <- as.data.frame((as_tibble(genes_info$chrominfo) %>%
                          dplyr::filter(chrom %in% (genes_info$transcripts %>% as_tibble() %>% .[['tx_chrom']]))))

  genes <- do.call(makeTxDb, genes_info)

  AnnotationDbi::saveDb(genes, file = "genes.sqlite")}
```

# Figure 1
## Panel A: Variant quantity & quality overview across GnomAD versions & sequencing datasets
```{r 1A}
Data <- Data %>%
        mutate(Version = ifelse(Version == "GnomADv4.1", "gnomADv4.1",
                         ifelse(Version == "GnomADv2.0", "gnomADv2.1.1", NA)))


# Common quality-assessment colors for Figure 1
qa_colors <- scales::alpha(c("Pass" = "#35B779",
                             "Fail → Pass" = "#73D055",
                             "Pass → Fail" = "#2A788E",
                             "Fail" = "#440154"), 0.7)

qa_scale <- function() {scale_fill_manual(name = "Quality assessment",
                                          values = qa_colors,
                                          limits = names(qa_colors),
                                          breaks = names(qa_colors),
                                          drop = FALSE)}


Fig1a <- Data %>%
         mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"),
                Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Exome", "Genome", "Joint")),
                Version = factor(Version, levels = c("gnomADv2.1.1", "gnomADv4.1")),
                Quality = ifelse(Quality == "Passed", "Pass", "Fail"),
                Quality = factor(Quality, levels = c("Pass", "Fail"))) %>%
         dplyr::select(ID, Version, Region, Quality) %>%
         group_by(Version, Region, Quality) %>%
         summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
         group_by(Version, Region) %>%
         mutate(Total = sum(Count),
                Percent = round(Count / Total * 100, 1)) %>%
         ungroup()

Fig1a

Fig1A <- Fig1a %>% 
         ggplot(aes(x = Region, y = Percent, fill = Quality)) +  
         geom_col(position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, padding = 0.1, preserve = "single"), width = 0.9) +
         facet_wrap(~ Version, strip.position = "top", scales = "free_x") +
         scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
         qa_scale() +
         scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
         geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.nan(Percent), paste0(Count, "\n(0%)"), paste0(Count, "\n(", sprintf("%.1f", Percent), "%)"))), 
                   position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, padding = 0.1, preserve = "single"),
                   vjust = -0.5, 
                   size = 3.5, 
                   family = "Arial") +
         guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +
         labs(fill = "Quality assessment",
              x = "Sequencing dataset",
              y = "Percentage of variants (%)") +
         theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 14) +
         theme(text = element_text(color = "black"),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
               plot.caption = element_text(size = 11.8, margin = margin(t = 6)),
               strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.8),
               legend.text = element_text(size = 11.8),
               legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.8),
               axis.text = element_text(size = 11.8),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.8),
               axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), hjust = 0.5),
               axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10), hjust = 0.5),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey80"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey90"),
               panel.spacing = unit(4, "lines"),
               strip.placement = "inside",
               strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F6F6F5", colour = "white"))

Fig1A
```

## Panel B: Variant novelty & quality assesment changes across GnomAD versions
```{r 1B}
Fig1b <- Data %>%
         dplyr::filter(Gene %in% c("HBA1", "HBA2", "HBB", "HBD",
                                   "HBE1", "HBG1", "HBG2", "HBZ"),
                       Region %in% c("Exome", "Genome")) %>%
         dplyr::mutate(Version = dplyr::case_when(as.character(Version) %in% c("GnomADv2.0", "gnomADv2.1.1") ~ "gnomADv2.1.1",
                                                  as.character(Version) %in% c("GnomADv4.1", "gnomADv4.1") ~ "gnomADv4.1",
                                                  TRUE ~ NA_character_),
                       ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"),
                       IsPass = as.character(Quality) == "Passed") %>%
         dplyr::filter(!is.na(Version)) %>%
         dplyr::group_by(ID) %>%
         dplyr::summarise(v2_present = any(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1"),
                          v4_present = any(Version == "gnomADv4.1"),
                          v2_pass = any(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1" & IsPass),
                          v4_pass = any(Version == "gnomADv4.1" & IsPass),
                          .groups = "drop") %>%
         dplyr::mutate(Category = dplyr::case_when(v2_present & v4_present ~ "Common to both releases",
                                                   v2_present & !v4_present ~ "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1",
                                                   !v2_present & v4_present ~ "Unique to gnomADv4.1",
                                                   TRUE ~ NA_character_),
                       Quality = dplyr::case_when(v2_present & v4_present & v2_pass & v4_pass ~ "Pass",
                                                  v2_present & v4_present & !v2_pass & v4_pass ~ "Fail → Pass",
                                                  v2_present & v4_present & v2_pass & !v4_pass ~ "Pass → Fail",
                                                  v2_present & v4_present & !v2_pass & !v4_pass ~ "Fail",
                                                  v2_present & !v4_present & v2_pass ~ "Pass",
                                                  v2_present & !v4_present & !v2_pass ~ "Fail",
                                                  !v2_present & v4_present & v4_pass ~ "Pass",
                                                  !v2_present & v4_present & !v4_pass ~ "Fail",
                                                  TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
         dplyr::count(Category, Quality, name = "Count") %>%
         dplyr::group_by(Category) %>%
         dplyr::mutate(Percent = round(Count / sum(Count) * 100, 1)) %>%
         dplyr::ungroup() %>%
         dplyr::mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Common to both releases",
                                                              "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1",
                                                              "Unique to gnomADv4.1")),
                       Quality = factor(Quality, levels = c("Pass",
                                                            "Fail → Pass",
                                                            "Pass → Fail",
                                                            "Fail")))

print(Fig1b)
print(Fig1b %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Category) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(Total = sum(Count), .groups = "drop"))

Fig1B <- ggplot(Fig1b,
                aes(x = Category, y = Percent, fill = Quality)) +
         geom_col(position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9,
                                             padding = 0.1,
                                             preserve = "single"),
                  width = 0.9) +
         geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s\n(%.1f%%)", Count, Percent),
                       group = Quality),
                   position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9,
                                              padding = 0.1,
                                              preserve = "single"),
                   vjust = -0.5,
                   size = 3.5,
                   family = "Arial",
                   lineheight = 0.95) +
         qa_scale() +
         scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100),
                            breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
                            expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
         
         scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Common to both releases" = "Common to both releases\n(n = 2,665)",
                                     "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1" = "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1\n(n = 146)",
                                     "Unique to gnomADv4.1" = "Unique to gnomADv4.1\n(n = 8,802)"),
                          expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
         guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1,
                                    title.position = "top",
                                    title.hjust = 0.5)) +
         labs(fill = "Quality assessment",
              x = "Variant membership in gnomAD releases",
              y = "Percentage of variants (%)") +
         theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial",
                       base_size = 14) +
         theme(text = element_text(color = "black"),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               legend.text = element_text(size = 11.8),
               legend.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                           size = 11.8),
               axis.text = element_text(size = 11.8),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         size = 11.8),
               axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
               axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted",
                                               color = "grey80"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = "dotted",
                                               color = "grey90"))

Fig1B
```

## Panel C: gnomADv4.1 release variant spread & quality assesment changes across sequencing datasets
```{r 1C}
Fig1c <- Data %>%
         filter(Version == "gnomADv4.1") %>%
         mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"),
                Quality_orig = ifelse(Quality == "Passed", "Pass", "Fail")) %>%
         dplyr::select(ID, Region, Quality_orig) %>%
         pivot_wider(names_from = Region,
                     values_from = Quality_orig,
                     values_fn = list(Quality_orig = dplyr::first),
                     values_fill = NA_character_) %>%
         mutate(Quality = case_when(Genome == "Pass" & Exome == "Pass" & Joint == "Pass" ~ "Pass",
                                    is.na(Genome) & Exome == "Pass" & Joint == "Pass" ~ "Pass",
                                    Genome == "Pass" & is.na(Exome) & Joint == "Pass" ~ "Pass",
                                    Genome == "Fail" & Exome == "Fail" & Joint == "Fail" ~ "Fail",
                                    is.na(Genome) & Exome == "Fail" & Joint == "Fail" ~ "Fail",
                                    Genome == "Fail" & is.na(Exome) & Joint == "Fail" ~ "Fail",
                                    (Genome == "Pass" | Exome == "Pass") & Joint == "Fail" ~ "Pass → Fail",
                                    (Genome == "Fail" | Exome == "Fail") & Joint == "Pass" ~ "Fail → Pass",
                                    is.na(Genome) & is.na(Exome) & Joint == "Pass" ~ "Pass",  
                                    is.na(Genome) & is.na(Exome) & Joint == "Fail" ~ "Fail", TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
         filter(!is.na(Quality)) %>%
         rowwise() %>%
         mutate(Regions = list(c(if(!is.na(Genome)) "Genome" else NULL,
                                 if(!is.na(Exome)) "Exome" else NULL,
                                 if(!is.na(Joint)) "Joint" else NULL))) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         filter(lengths(Regions) > 0) %>%  
         dplyr::select(ID, Regions, Quality) %>%
         group_by(Regions, Quality) %>%
         summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
         group_by(Regions) %>%
         mutate(Total = sum(Count),   
                Percent = round(Count / Total * 100, 1),
                Quality = factor(Quality, levels = c("Pass", "Fail → Pass", "Pass → Fail", "Fail"))) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         mutate(Regions = vapply(Regions, paste, character(1), collapse = " ∩ "),
                Regions = factor(Regions, levels = c("Genome ∩ Exome ∩ Joint", setdiff(sort(unique(Regions)), "Genome ∩ Exome ∩ Joint"))))

Fig1c

Fig1C <- ggplot(Fig1c, aes(x = Regions, y = Percent, fill = Quality)) +
         geom_col(position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, padding = 0.1, preserve = "single"), width = 0.9) +
         geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Count, "\n(", sprintf("%.1f", Percent), "%)")),
                   position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, padding = 0.1, preserve = "single"),
                   vjust = -0.5,
                   size = 3.5,
                   family = "Arial",
                   show.legend = FALSE) +
          scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
          qa_scale() +
          scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
          guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +
          labs(fill = "Quality assessment",
               x = "Callset overlap in gnomADv4.1",
               y = "Percentage of variants (%)") +
          theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial", base_size = 14) +
          theme(text = element_text(color = "black"),
                legend.position = "bottom",
                plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
                plot.caption = element_text(size = 11.8, margin = margin(t = 6)),
                strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.8),
                legend.text = element_text(size = 11.8),
                legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.8),
                axis.text = element_text(size = 11.8),
                axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.8),
                axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10), hjust = 0.5),
                axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10), hjust = 0.5),
                panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey80"),
                panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey90"),
                panel.spacing = unit(4, "lines"),
                strip.placement = "inside",
                strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F6F6F5", colour = "white"))

Fig1C
```

## Compile Figure 1
```{r Fig1}
Fig1A_final <- Fig1A +
               guides(fill = "none") +
               coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 115),
                               clip = "off",
                               expand = FALSE) +
               theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 8, 12, 8))

Fig1B_final <- Fig1B +
               labs(caption = "Quality assessment transitions: gnomAD v2.1.1 → v4.1") +
               guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1,
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5)) +
               coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 115),
                               clip = "off",
                               expand = FALSE) +
                theme(plot.caption.position = "plot",
                      plot.caption = element_text(family = "Arial",
                                                  size = 10,
                                                  colour = "grey35",
                                                  hjust = 1,
                                                  margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5)),
                      plot.margin = margin(10, 8, 12, 8))

Fig1C_final <- Fig1C +
               labs(caption = paste0("Quality assessment transitions: individual exome/genome ",
                                     "→ joint callset")) +
               guides(fill = "none") +
               coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 115),
                               clip = "off",
                               expand = FALSE) +
               theme(plot.caption.position = "plot",
                     plot.caption = element_text(family = "Arial",
                                                 size = 10,
                                                 colour = "grey35",
                                                 hjust = 1,
                                                 margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5)),
                     plot.margin = margin(10, 8, 12, 8))

# Assemble figure using a dedicated bottom legend area
Fig1 <- (Fig1A_final +
         Fig1B_final +
         Fig1C_final +
         guide_area() +
        plot_layout(ncol = 1,
                    heights = c(1, 1.15, 1.15, 0.18),
                    guides = "collect") +
        plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B", "C")),
                        theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(family = "Arial",
                                                              face = "bold",
                                                              size = 16,
                                                              hjust = 0),
                                      plot.tag.location = "margin",
                                      plot.tag.position = "topleft",
                                      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)))) &
                       theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                             legend.justification = "center",
                             legend.direction = "horizontal",
                             legend.box = "vertical")

Fig1

ggsave(filename = paste0("Fig1.png"),
       plot = Fig1,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300,
       width = 10.5,
       height = 12)

rm(Fig1A_final, Fig1B_final, Fig1C_final, qa_scale, qa_colors)
```

# Extra
```{r summaries}
G2 <- Data %>% filter(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1" & Region == "Genome") %>% nrow()
E2 <- Data %>% filter(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1" & Region == "Exome") %>% nrow()

E4 <- Data %>% filter(Version == "gnomADv4.1" & Region == "Exome") %>% nrow()

E2P <- Data %>% filter(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1" & Region == "Exome" & Quality == "Passed") %>% nrow()
G4P <- Data %>% filter(Version == "gnomADv4.1" & Region == "Genome" & Quality == "Passed") %>% nrow()
E4P <- Data %>% filter(Version == "gnomADv4.1" & Region == "Exome" & Quality == "Passed") %>% nrow()
```

# Figure 2: Characterization of variants unique to gnomAD releases that pass quality assessment per gene and ClinVar annotation
```{r 2}
pct_label <- function(x) {x <- round(x, 1)
                          ifelse(x == 0 | x == 100,
                                 sprintf("%.0f%%", x),
                                 sprintf("%.1f%%", x))}

gene_levels <- c("HBA1", "HBA2", "HBB", "HBD", "HBE1", "HBG1", "HBG2", "HBZ")

release_levels <- c("Unique to gnomADv2.1.1",
                    "Unique to gnomADv4.1")

class_bottom_to_top <- c("Not available",
                         "Benign/Likely benign",
                         "Uncertain significance",
                         "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic")

Fig2_source <- Data %>%
               dplyr::filter(Gene %in% gene_levels,
                             as.character(Region) %in% c("Exome", "Genome")) %>%
               dplyr::mutate(Version = dplyr::case_when(as.character(Version) %in% c("GnomADv2.0", "gnomADv2.1.1") ~ "gnomADv2.1.1",
                                                        as.character(Version) %in% c("GnomADv4.1", "gnomADv4.1") ~ "gnomADv4.1",
                                                        TRUE ~ NA_character_),
                             ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"),
                             QA = as.character(Quality),
                             IsPass = QA %in% c("Passed", "Pass"),
                             ClinVar_raw = trimws(as.character(ClinVar)),
                             ClinVar_group = dplyr::case_when(is.na(ClinVar_raw) |  ClinVar_raw %in% c("", "Not available",
                                                                                                       "no_classification_for_the_single_variant") ~ "Not available",
                                                              ClinVar_raw %in% c("Benign",
                                                                                 "Likely_benign",
                                                                                 "Benign/Likely_benign",
                                                                                 "Benign/Likely benign") ~ "Benign/Likely benign",
                                                              ClinVar_raw %in% c("Pathogenic",
                                                                                 "Likely_pathogenic",
                                                                                 "Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic",
                                                                                 "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic") ~ "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic",
                                                              ClinVar_raw %in% c("Uncertain_significance",
                                                                                 "Uncertain significance",
                                                                                 "other",
                                                                                 "Pathogenic|other",
                                                                                 "Conflicting_classifications_of_pathogenicity") ~ "Uncertain significance",
                                                              TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>%
               dplyr::filter(!is.na(Version)) 

Fig2_status <- Fig2_source %>%
               dplyr::group_by(ID) %>%
               dplyr::summarise(v2_present = any(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1"),
                                v4_present = any(Version == "gnomADv4.1"),
                                v2_pass = any(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1" & IsPass),
                                v4_pass = any(Version == "gnomADv4.1" & IsPass),
                                .groups = "drop") %>%
               dplyr::mutate(Category = dplyr::case_when(v2_present & !v4_present ~ release_levels[1],
                                                         !v2_present & v4_present ~ release_levels[2],
                                                         TRUE ~ "Common to both releases")) %>%
               dplyr::filter((Category == release_levels[1] & v2_pass) | (Category == release_levels[2] & v4_pass))

Fig2_metadata <- Fig2_source  %>%
                 dplyr::group_by(ID) %>%
                 dplyr::summarise(n_genes = dplyr::n_distinct(Gene),
                                  n_clinical_classes = dplyr::n_distinct(ClinVar_group[ClinVar_group != "Not available"]),
                                  Gene = dplyr::first(Gene),
                                  ClinVar = {annotated <- unique(ClinVar_group[ClinVar_group != "Not available"])
                                  
                                  if (length(annotated) == 0L) {"Not available"} else {annotated[1]}}, .groups = "drop")

Fig2 <- Fig2_status  %>%
        dplyr::left_join(Fig2_metadata %>%
                         dplyr::select(ID, Gene, ClinVar),
                         by = "ID") %>%
        dplyr::count(Category, Gene, ClinVar, name = "Count")

Fig2b <- tidyr::expand_grid(Category = factor(release_levels, levels = release_levels),
                            Gene = factor(gene_levels, levels = gene_levels),
                            ClinVar = factor(class_bottom_to_top, levels = class_bottom_to_top)) %>%
         dplyr::left_join(Fig2 %>%
                          dplyr::mutate(Category = factor(Category, levels = release_levels),
                                        Gene = factor(Gene, levels = gene_levels),
                                        ClinVar = factor(ClinVar, levels = class_bottom_to_top)),
                          by = c("Category", "Gene", "ClinVar")) %>%
         dplyr::mutate(Count = dplyr::coalesce(Count, 0L)) %>%
         dplyr::group_by(Category, Gene) %>%
         dplyr::mutate(Total = sum(Count),
                       Percent = if_else(Total > 0,
                                         100 * Count / Total,
                                         0),
                       Label = if_else(Count == 0L,
                                       "—",
                                       paste0(scales::comma(Count),
                                              "\n(",
                                              pct_label(Percent),
                                              ")"))) %>%
         dplyr::ungroup()

Fig2b

Fig2a <- Fig2b %>%
         dplyr::distinct(Category, Gene, Total)

Fig2a

Fig2A <- ggplot(Fig2a,
                aes(x = Gene, y = Total)) +
         geom_point(size = 3,
                    colour = "black") +
         geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(Total)),
                   vjust = -0.85,
                   size = 3.2,
                   colour = "black") +
         facet_grid(~ Category) +
         scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
         scale_y_log10(limits = c(3,
                                  max(1500, max(Fig2a$Total) * 1.6)),
                       breaks = c(10, 100, 1000),
                       labels = scales::label_comma()) +
         labs(x = NULL,
              y = "Number of variants") +
         theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial",
                       base_size = 12) +
         theme(text = element_text(colour = "black"),
               strip.text = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         size = 12),
               strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#F6F6F5",
                                               colour = "white"),
               axis.text.x = element_blank(),
               axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
               axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold",
                                           margin = margin(r = 10)),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted",
                                               colour = "grey80"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = "dotted",
                                               colour = "grey90"),
               panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
               legend.position = "none")

Fig2B <- ggplot(Fig2b,
                aes(x = Gene,
                    y = ClinVar,
                    fill = Percent)) +
         geom_tile(width = 0.96,
                   height = 0.90,
                   colour = "white",
                   linewidth = 0.7) +
         geom_text(aes(label = Label,
                       colour = Percent >= 60),
                   size = 3,
                   lineheight = 0.92) +
         scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "black",
                                       "TRUE" = "white"),
                            guide = "none") +
         scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("white",
                                          "#35B779",
                                          "#2A788E",
                                          "#440154"),
                              limits = c(0, 100),
                              breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
                              labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
                              name = "Within-gene percentage (%)",
                              guide = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top",
                                                      title.hjust = 0.5)) +
         scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
         facet_grid(~ Category) +
         labs(x = "Gene",
              y = "ClinVar variant classification") +
         theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial",
                       base_size = 12) +
         theme(text = element_text(colour = "black"),
               strip.text = element_blank(),
               axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
               axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 8)),
               axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
               panel.grid = element_blank(),
               panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
               legend.box = "vertical")

Fig2 <- (Fig2A / Fig2B) +
         plot_layout(ncol = 1,
                     heights = c(1, 2.3)) +
         plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B")),
                         theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(family = "Arial",
                                                               face = "bold",
                                                               size = 16),
                                       plot.tag.position = "topleft",
                                       plot.tag.location = "margin",
                                       plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 10)))

Fig2

ggsave(filename = paste0("Fig2.png"),
       plot = Fig2,
       width = 12.5,
       height = 8.5,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300)
```

## Panel B: gnomADv4.1 release variants passing quality check that are unique to a single genetic ancestry group

**Genetic ancestry groups:**
 * **ALL:** Global
 * **FIN:** Finnish European
 * **NFE:** Non-Finnish European
 * **AMR:** Admixed American
 * **MID:** Middle Eastern
 * **ASJ:** Ashkenazi Jewish
 * **EAS:** East Asian
 * **SAS:** South Asian
 * **AFR:** African/African American
 * **AMI:** Amish
 * **OTH:** Remaining individuals that cannot be clustered into any of the above ethnic groups using Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
```{r 3B}
Total <- Data %>% 
         filter(Version == "gnomADv4.1" & Region == "Joint" & Quality == "Passed") %>% 
         nrow()

Total2 <- Data %>% 
          filter(Version == "gnomADv4.1" & Region == "Joint" & Quality == "Passed") %>%
          dplyr::select(Chromosome, Gene, Start, End, Ref, Alt, Allele.Count_AFR, Allele.Count_AMI, 
                                Allele.Count_AMR, Allele.Count_ASJ, Allele.Count_EAS, Allele.Count_FIN, 
                                Allele.Count_MID, Allele.Count_NFE, Allele.Count_SAS, Allele.Count_OTH) %>%
          pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Allele.Count_"),
                       names_to = "Ancestry",
                       names_prefix = "Allele.Count_",
                       values_to = "Allele_Count") %>%
          filter(Allele_Count != 0 & !is.na(Allele_Count)) %>%
          group_by(Ancestry) %>%
          mutate(Total2 = n()) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          dplyr::select(Ancestry, Total2) %>%
          distinct()

Fig3b <- Data %>% 
         filter(Version == "gnomADv4.1" & Region == "Joint" & Quality == "Passed") %>%
         dplyr::select(Chromosome, Gene, Start, End, Ref, Alt, Allele.Count_AFR, Allele.Count_AMI, 
                               Allele.Count_AMR, Allele.Count_ASJ, Allele.Count_EAS, Allele.Count_FIN, 
                               Allele.Count_MID, Allele.Count_NFE, Allele.Count_SAS, Allele.Count_OTH) %>%
         pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Allele.Count_"),
                      names_to = "Ancestry",
                      names_prefix = "Allele.Count_",
                      values_to = "Allele_Count") %>%
         filter(Allele_Count != 0 & !is.na(Allele_Count)) %>%
         mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_")) %>%
         group_by(ID) %>%
         mutate(Count = n()) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         filter(Count == 1) %>%
         dplyr::select(Chromosome, Start, End, Ref, Alt, Ancestry, Count) %>%
         group_by(Ancestry) %>%
         summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
         complete(Ancestry = c("AFR", "AMI", "AMR", "ASJ", "EAS", "FIN", "MID", "NFE", "OTH", "SAS"), 
                  fill = list(Count = 0)) %>%

                                                       "AMR", "EAS", "ASJ", "MID", "AMI"))) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         left_join(Total2, by = "Ancestry") %>%
         mutate(Percent2 = round(Count / Total2 * 100, 1),
                Percent2 = ifelse(is.nan(Percent2) | is.na(Percent2), 0, Percent2))
```

```{r Fig2}
Target <- Reduce(function(a, b) unit.pmax(a, b),
                 list(LeftGutter(Fig3A),
                      LeftGutter(Fig3B),   
                      LeftGutter(Fig3C)))

Fig3 <- (LeftPadding(Fig3A, Target) /
         LeftPadding(Fig3B, Target) /
         LeftPadding(Fig3C, Target)) +
        plot_layout(ncol = 1,
                    heights = c(1, 1.5, 1),
                    guides = "collect") +
        plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", "B", "C")),
                        theme = theme(plot.tag = element_text(family = "Arial",
                                                              face = "bold",
                                                              size = 16,
                                                              hjust = 0.5,
                                                              vjust = 1),
                                      plot.tag.location = "plot",
                                      plot.tag.position = c(0.12, 1),
                                      plot.margin = margin(1, 2, 1, 2)))

Fig3

ggsave(filename = "Fig3.png",
       plot = Fig3,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 300,
       width = 8.77,
       height = 9.5)

rm(LeftGutter, LeftPadding)
```

# Figure 4 
## Data preparation
```{r Fig4prep}
# GnomAD v4.1
Data1 <- Data %>% 
         filter(Region == "Joint" & Version == "gnomADv4.1" & Quality == "Passed") %>%
         rowwise() %>%
         mutate(FAF95_MAX = max(c(FAF95_AFR, 
                                  FAF95_AMR, 
                                  FAF95_EAS, 
                                  FAF95_NFE, 
                                  FAF95_SAS), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
         mutate(FAF95_MAXETH = {Index <- which(c(FAF95_AFR, 
                                                 FAF95_AMR, 
                                                 FAF95_EAS, 
                                                 FAF95_NFE, 
                                                 FAF95_SAS) == max(c(FAF95_AFR, 
                                                                     FAF95_AMR,
                                                                     FAF95_EAS, 
                                                                     FAF95_NFE, 
                                                                     FAF95_SAS), na.rm = TRUE))
         
                                if (length(Index) == 1) {c("AFR", "AMR", "EAS", "NFE", "SAS")[Index]} 
         
                                # In cases of tied max FAF95, report FAF95 with greatest variant count
                                else {Index2 <- Index[which(c(Allele.Count_AFR,
                                                              Allele.Count_AMR, 
                                                              Allele.Count_EAS, 
                                                              Allele.Count_NFE, 
                                                              Allele.Count_SAS)[Index] == max(c(Allele.Count_AFR,
                                                                                                Allele.Count_AMR,
                                                                                                Allele.Count_EAS,
                                                                                                Allele.Count_NFE, 
                                                                                                Allele.Count_SAS)[Index], na.rm = TRUE))]
                                
                                      if (length(Index2) == 1) {c("AFR", "AMR", "EAS", "NFE", "SAS")[Index2]} 
                                
                                      # In cases of tied max FAF95 & allele count, report FAF95 with greatest number of alleles tested
                                      else {Max <- max(c(Allele.Total_AFR,
                                                         Allele.Total_AMR, 
                                                         Allele.Total_EAS, 
                                                         Allele.Total_NFE, 
                                                         Allele.Total_SAS)[Index2], na.rm = TRUE)
                                      
                                            c("AFR",
                                              "AMR",
                                              "EAS",
                                              "NFE", 
                                              "SAS")[Index2[which.max(c(Allele.Total_AFR, 
                                                                        Allele.Total_AMR, 
                                                                        Allele.Total_EAS,
                                                                        Allele.Total_NFE,
                                                                        Allele.Total_SAS)[Index2])]]}}}) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         mutate(Count = case_when(FAF95_MAXETH == "AFR" ~ Allele.Count_AFR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "AMR" ~ Allele.Count_AMR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "EAS" ~ Allele.Count_EAS,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "NFE" ~ Allele.Count_NFE,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "SAS" ~ Allele.Count_SAS,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "MID" ~ Allele.Count_MID,
                                  TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
                Total = case_when(FAF95_MAXETH == "AFR" ~ Allele.Total_AFR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "AMR" ~ Allele.Total_AMR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "EAS" ~ Allele.Total_EAS,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "NFE" ~ Allele.Total_NFE,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "SAS" ~ Allele.Total_SAS,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "MID" ~ Allele.Total_MID,
                                  TRUE ~ NA_integer_)) %>% 
         dplyr::select(Chromosome, Gene, Start, End, Ref, Alt, Allele.Frequency_ALL, Homozygotes_ALL, FAF95_MAX, Count, Total, ClinVar, Stars) %>%
         distinct() %>%
         mutate(BA1 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.005, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # 95% MAX FAF >= 0.005 (0.5%) where allele total >= 2000 & allele count >= 5
                BS1 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.001 & FAF95_MAX < 0.005, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # 95% MAX FAF >= 0.001 (0.1%) where allele total >= 2000 & allele count >= 5 [Excludes BA1 range]
                PM2_Supporting = ifelse(Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),        # ALL AF < 0.0001 (0.01%)
                BS2 = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL >= 2, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),                            # 2 >= Homozygotes
                BS2_Supporting = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL == 1, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),                 # 1 == Homozygote
                Conflict_BS2_PM2 = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL >= 2 & Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # Meets both criteria [evidence for benign & pathogenic]
                Conflict_BS1_PM2 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.001 & FAF95_MAX < 0.005 & Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied")) %>% # Meets both criteria [evidence for benign & pathogenic]
         mutate(ClinVar = ifelse(ClinVar == "Uncertain_significance", "Uncertain significance", 
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", 
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "Likely_benign", "Benign/Likely benign", 
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "Benign/Likely_benign", "Benign/Likely benign", 
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "other", "Uncertain significance", 
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "Likely_pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", 
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "Benign", "Benign/Likely benign",
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic|other", "Uncertain significance", 
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "Conflicting_classifications_of_pathogenicity", "Uncertain significance",
                          ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", NA)))))))))))  %>%
         mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, End, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"))

# GnomAD v2.1.1
Data2 <- Data %>% 
         filter(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1" & Region != "Joint" & Quality == "Passed") %>%
         rowwise() %>%
         mutate(FAF95_MAX = max(c(FAF95_AFR, 
                                  FAF95_AMR, 
                                  FAF95_EAS, 
                                  FAF95_NFE, 
                                  FAF95_SAS), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
         mutate(FAF95_MAXETH = {Index <- which(c(FAF95_AFR, 
                                                 FAF95_AMR,

                                                                     FAF95_AMR,
                                                                     FAF95_EAS, 
                                                                     FAF95_NFE, 
                                                                     FAF95_SAS), na.rm = TRUE))
         
                                if (length(Index) == 1) {c("AFR", "AMR", "EAS", "NFE", "SAS")[Index]} 
         
                                # In cases of tied max FAF95, report FAF95 with greatest variant count
                                else {Index2 <- Index[which(c(Allele.Count_AFR,
                                                              Allele.Count_AMR, 
                                                              Allele.Count_EAS,

                                                                                                Allele.Count_EAS,
                                                                                                Allele.Count_NFE, 
                                                                                                Allele.Count_SAS)[Index], na.rm = TRUE))]
                                
                                      if (length(Index2) == 1) {c("AFR", "AMR", "EAS", "NFE", "SAS")[Index2]} 
                                
                                      # In cases of tied max FAF95 & allele count, report FAF95 with greatest number of alleles tested
                                      else {Max <- max(c(Allele.Total_AFR,
                                                         Allele.Total_AMR, 
                                                         Allele.Total_EAS, 
                                                         Allele.Total_NFE, 
                                                         Allele.Total_SAS)[Index2], na.rm = TRUE)
                                      
                                            c("AFR",
                                              "AMR",
                                              "EAS",
                                              "NFE", 
                                              "SAS")[Index2[which.max(c(Allele.Total_AFR, 
                                                                        Allele.Total_AMR, 
                                                                        Allele.Total_EAS,
                                                                        Allele.Total_NFE,
                                                                        Allele.Total_SAS)[Index2])]]}}}) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         mutate(Count = case_when(FAF95_MAXETH == "AFR" ~ Allele.Count_AFR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "AMR" ~ Allele.Count_AMR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "EAS" ~ Allele.Count_EAS,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "NFE" ~ Allele.Count_NFE,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "SAS" ~ Allele.Count_SAS,
                                  TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
                Total = case_when(FAF95_MAXETH == "AFR" ~ Allele.Total_AFR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "AMR" ~ Allele.Total_AMR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "EAS" ~ Allele.Total_EAS,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "NFE" ~ Allele.Total_NFE,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "SAS" ~ Allele.Total_SAS,
                                  TRUE ~ NA_integer_)) %>%
         group_by(Chromosome, Gene, Start, Ref, Alt) %>%
         mutate(Allele.Frequency_ALL = max(Allele.Frequency_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
                Homozygotes_ALL = max(Homozygotes_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
                FAF95_MAX = max(FAF95_MAX, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
         slice_max(order_by = FAF95_MAX, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
         ungroup() %>%
         dplyr::select(Chromosome, Gene, Start, End, Ref, Alt, Allele.Frequency_ALL, Homozygotes_ALL, FAF95_MAX, Count, Total, ClinVar, Stars) %>%
         distinct() %>%
         mutate(BA1 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.005, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # 95% MAX FAF >= 0.005 (0.5%) where allele total >= 2000 & allele count >= 5
                BS1 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.001 & FAF95_MAX < 0.005, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # 95% MAX FAF >= 0.001 (0.1%) where allele total >= 2000 & allele count >= 5 [Exlcudes BA1 range]
                PM2_Supporting = ifelse(Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),        # ALL AF < 0.0001 (0.01%)
                BS2 = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL >= 2, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),                            # 2 >= Homozygotes
                BS2_Supporting = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL == 1, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),                 # 1 == Homozygote
                Conflict_BS2_PM2 = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL >= 2 & Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # Meets both criteria [evidence for benign & pathogenic]
                Conflict_BS1_PM2 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.001 & FAF95_MAX < 0.005 & Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied")) %>%  # Meets both criteria [evidence for benign & pathogenic]
        mutate(ClinVar = ifelse(ClinVar == "Uncertain_significance", "Uncertain significance", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Likely_benign", "Benign/Likely benign", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Benign/Likely_benign", "Benign/Likely benign", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "other", "Uncertain significance",

                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic|other", "Uncertain significance", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Conflicting_classifications_of_pathogenicity", "Uncertain significance",
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", NA))))))))))) %>%
        mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, End, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"))
```

## Panel A: Overview of BA1, BS1, BS2, BS2_Supporting and PM2_Supporting evidence across variants passing quality assessment per gnomAD release
```{r Fig4A}
criteria <- c("BA1", "BS1", "BS2", "BS2_Supporting", "PM2_Supporting")
headers <- c("gnomADv2.1.1" = "gnomAD v2.1.1",
             "gnomADv4.1"   = "gnomAD v4.1")
release_levels <- names(headers)

pct_label4 <- function(n, total) {p <- round(100 * n / total, 1)
                                  ifelse(n == 0, "0%",
                                         ifelse(p == 0, "<0.1%",
                                                ifelse(p == 100, "100%", sprintf("%.1f%%", p))))}

raw_presence <- Data %>%
                dplyr::mutate(Version = dplyr::case_when(as.character(Version) %in% c("GnomADv2.0", "gnomADv2.1.1") ~ "gnomADv2.1.1",
                                                         as.character(Version) %in% c("GnomADv4.1", "gnomADv4.1") ~ "gnomADv4.1",
                                                         TRUE ~ NA_character_),
                              Key = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_")) %>%
                dplyr::filter((Version == "gnomADv2.1.1" & Region %in% c("Exome", "Genome")) | (Version == "gnomADv4.1" & Region == "Joint")) %>%
                dplyr::distinct(Key, Version) %>%
                dplyr::group_by(Key) %>%
                dplyr::summarise(present_v2 = any(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1"),
                                 present_v4 = any(Version == "gnomADv4.1"),
                                 .groups = "drop") %>%
                dplyr::mutate(Membership = if_else(present_v2 & present_v4,
                                                   "Common to both releases", "Unique to one release")) %>%
                dplyr::select(Key, Membership)

Fig4_source <- dplyr::bind_rows(Data2 %>% dplyr::mutate(Version = "gnomADv2.1.1"),
                                Data1 %>% dplyr::mutate(Version = "gnomADv4.1")) %>%
               dplyr::mutate(Key = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"),
                             Version = factor(Version, levels = release_levels)) %>%
               dplyr::left_join(raw_presence, by = "Key") %>%
               dplyr::mutate(Membership = factor(Membership, levels = c("Common to both releases", "Unique to one release")))

Fig4a <- Fig4_source %>%
         dplyr::select(Version, Membership, dplyr::all_of(criteria)) %>%
         tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(criteria),
                             names_to = "Criterion", values_to = "Response") %>%
         dplyr::group_by(Version, Criterion, Membership) %>%
         dplyr::summarise(Count = sum(Response == "Satisfied", na.rm = TRUE),
                          .groups = "drop") %>%
         dplyr::mutate(Criterion = factor(Criterion, levels = criteria),
                       X = match(as.character(Criterion), criteria)) %>%
         dplyr::arrange(Version, X, Membership) %>%
         dplyr::group_by(Version, Criterion) %>%
         dplyr::mutate(StackTop = cumsum(Count),
                       StackBottom = StackTop - Count) %>%
         dplyr::ungroup()

Fig4a_labels <- Fig4a %>%
                dplyr::group_by(Version, Criterion, X) %>%
                dplyr::summarise(Total = sum(Count),
                                 Common = sum(Count[Membership == "Common to both releases"]),
                                 Unique = sum(Count[Membership == "Unique to one release"]),
                                 .groups = "drop") %>%
                dplyr::mutate(LabelY = pmax(Total + 120, 320))


Fig4a_labels <- Fig4a %>%
                dplyr::group_by(Version, Criterion, X) %>%
                dplyr::summarise(Total = sum(Count),
                                 Common = sum(Count[Membership == "Common to both releases"]),
                                 Unique = sum(Count[Membership == "Unique to one release"]),
                                 .groups = "drop") %>%
                dplyr::mutate(N_release = if_else(as.character(Version) == "gnomADv2.1.1",
                                                  2185L, 5021L),
                              TotalLabel = paste0("Total:\n",
                                                  scales::comma(Total),
                                                  " (", pct_label4(Total, N_release), ")"),
                              CountY = pmax(Total + 150, 310),
                              TotalY = CountY + 610)

Fig4A <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
         ggplot2::geom_rect(data = Fig4a %>% dplyr::filter(Count > 0),
                            ggplot2::aes(xmin = X - 0.34, xmax = X + 0.34,

                            colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) +
         geom_text(data = Fig4a_labels,
                   aes(x = X - 0.10,
                       y = CountY,

                   family = "Arial",
                   fontface = "bold",
                   size = 2.8,
                   colour = "#176B55",
                   hjust = 1) +
```

## Panel C: Comparison of BA1, BS1, BS2, BS2_Supporting and PM2_Supporting evidence across variants passing quality assessment common to both gnomAD releases
```{r Fig4C}
Fig4c <- bind_rows(Data1 %>% mutate(Version = "gnomADv4.1"),
                   Data2 %>% mutate(Version = "gnomADv2.1.1")) %>%
         dplyr::select(ID, Version, BA1, BS1, BS2, BS2_Supporting, PM2_Supporting) %>%
         pivot_longer(cols = c(BA1, BS1, BS2, BS2_Supporting, PM2_Supporting),
                      names_to = "Category",
                      values_to = "Response") %>%
         pivot_wider(names_from = Version,
                     values_from = Response) %>%
         mutate(Status = case_when(!is.na(`gnomADv2.1.1`) & !is.na(`gnomADv4.1`) ~ "Common to both releases",
                                   is.na(`gnomADv2.1.1`) & !is.na(`gnomADv4.1`) ~ "Unique to gnomADv4.1",
                                   !is.na(`gnomADv2.1.1`) & is.na(`gnomADv4.1`) ~ "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1"),
                Response = case_when(Status != "Common to both releases" ~ NA_character_,
                                     `gnomADv2.1.1` == "Satisfied" & `gnomADv4.1` == "Satisfied" ~ "Satisfied",
                                     `gnomADv2.1.1` == "Not satisfied" & `gnomADv4.1` == "Not satisfied" ~ "Not satisfied",
                                     `gnomADv2.1.1` == "Satisfied" & `gnomADv4.1` == "Not satisfied" ~ "Satisfied → Not satisfied",
                                     `gnomADv2.1.1` == "Not satisfied" & `gnomADv4.1` == "Satisfied" ~ "Not satisfied → Satisfied")) %>%
         filter(Status == "Common to both releases") %>%
         group_by(Category) %>%
         mutate(Total = n()) %>% 
         ungroup() %>%
         filter(Response != "Not satisfied") %>%
         group_by(Category, Response) %>%
         summarise(Count = n(),
                   Total = first(Total), .groups = "drop") %>%
         mutate(Percent = round(Count / Total * 100, 1),
                Response = ifelse(Response == "Satisfied", "Met", 
                           ifelse(Response == "Not satisfied → Satisfied", "Not met → Met", 
                           ifelse(Response == "Satisfied → Not satisfied", "Met → Not met", NA))),
                Response = factor(Response, levels = c("Met", "Not met → Met", "Met → Not met")),
                Category = factor(Category, levels = c("BA1", "BS1", "BS2", "BS2_Supporting", "PM2_Supporting")))

Fig4c

Fig4C <- ggplot(Fig4c, aes(x = Category, y = Count, fill = Response)) +
```

## Panel B: Comparison of BA1, BS1, BS2, PM2_Supporting & grey/conflicting evidence of gnomADv4.1 release variants passing quality assessment with Clinvar annotations
```{r Fig5B}
Fig5b <- Data1 %>%
         dplyr::select(ClinVar, BA1, BS1, BS2, BS2_Supporting, PM2_Supporting) %>%
         pivot_longer(cols = c(BA1, BS1, BS2, BS2_Supporting, PM2_Supporting),
                      names_to = "Category", values_to = "Response") %>%
         group_by(Category) %>%
         mutate(Total = n()) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         filter(Response == "Satisfied" & !is.na(ClinVar)) %>%
         group_by(ClinVar, Category) %>%
         mutate(Count = n(),
                Percent = round(Count / Total * 100, 1),
                Percent = ifelse(Percent == 0, round(Count / Total * 100, 2), Percent),
                Category = factor(Category, level = c("BA1", "BS1", "BS2", "BS2_Supporting", "PM2_Supporting")),
                ClinVar = factor(ClinVar, level = c("Benign/Likely benign", "Uncertain significance", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"))) %>%
         distinct()

Fig5b

# Consistent color scheme
clinvar_colors <- alpha(c("Benign/Likely benign" = "#35B779",
                          "Uncertain significance" = "#2A788E",
                          "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic" = "#440154"), 0.7)

dodge <- position_dodge2(width = 0.9,
                         padding = 0.1,
                         preserve = "single")

# Function for both panels
make_panel <- function(data, panel_title) {ggplot(data, aes(x = Category, y = Count, fill = ClinVar)) +
                                           geom_col(position = dodge,
                                                    width = 0.9) +
                                           geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Count, "\n(", sprintf("%.1f", Percent), "%)"),
                                                         group = ClinVar),
                                                     position = dodge,
                                                     vjust = -0.4,
                                                     size = 3.5,
                                                     family = "Arial") +
                                           scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.4)) +
                                           scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.6))) +
                                           scale_fill_manual(values = clinvar_colors, drop = FALSE) +
                                           labs(title = NULL,
                                                x = panel_title,
                                                y = "Number of variants",
                                                fill = "ClinVar variant classification") +
                                           guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1,
                                                                      title.position = "top",
                                                                      title.hjust = 0.5)) +
                                           theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial") +
                                           theme(text = element_text(color = "black"),
                                                 plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
                                                 legend.position = "bottom",
                                                 legend.text = element_text(size = 11.8),
                                                 legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.8),
                                                 axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
                                                 axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11.8),
                                                 axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
                                                 panel.grid.major = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey80"),
                                                 panel.grid.minor = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey90"))}

p1 <- Fig5b %>%
      filter(Category != "PM2_Supporting") %>%
      make_panel("Criteria supporting \na benign classification")

p2 <- Fig5b %>%
      filter(Category == "PM2_Supporting") %>%
      make_panel("Criteria supporting \na pathogenic classification")

Fig5B <- (p1 | p2) +
         plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1.7),
                     guides = "collect") +
         plot_annotation(caption = "Note: Panels use different y-axis scales.") &
         theme(legend.position = "bottom")

Fig5B
```

# Overview of variants passing quality assessment unique to GnomADv2.0 satisfaction of ACMG/AMP criteria
```{r v2unique}
v2_Unique <- Data %>%
             mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_")) %>%
             filter(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1") %>%
             semi_join(Data %>%
                       filter(Region != "Joint") %>%
                       mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"),
                              Region = factor(Region, levels = c("Exome", "Genome")),
                              Version = factor(Version, levels = c("gnomADv2.1.1", "gnomADv4.1")),
                              Quality = ifelse(Quality == "Passed", "Pass", "Fail"),
                              Quality = factor(Quality, levels = c("Pass", "Fail"))) %>%
                       dplyr::select(ID, Version, Region, Quality) %>%
                       pivot_wider(names_from = Version,
                                   values_from = Quality,
                                   names_prefix = "Q_",
                                   values_fn = list(Quality = dplyr::first),
                                   values_fill = list(Quality = NA_character_)) %>%
                       mutate(Category = case_when(!is.na(Q_gnomADv2.1.1) & !is.na(Q_gnomADv4.1) ~ "Common to both releases",
                                                   !is.na(Q_gnomADv2.1.1) &  is.na(Q_gnomADv4.1) ~ "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1",
                                                   is.na(Q_gnomADv2.1.1) & !is.na(Q_gnomADv4.1) ~ "Unique to gnomADv4.1"),
                              Quality = case_when(Category == "Common to both releases" & Q_gnomADv2.1.1 == "Pass" & Q_gnomADv4.1 == "Pass" ~ "Pass",
                                                  Category == "Common to both releases" & Q_gnomADv2.1.1 == "Fail" & Q_gnomADv4.1 == "Fail" ~ "Fail",
                                                  Category == "Common to both releases" & Q_gnomADv2.1.1 == "Pass" & Q_gnomADv4.1 == "Fail" ~ "Pass → Fail",
                                                  Category == "Common to both releases" & Q_gnomADv2.1.1 == "Fail" & Q_gnomADv4.1 == "Pass" ~ "Fail → Pass",
                                                  Category == "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1" & Q_gnomADv2.1.1 == "Pass" ~ "Pass",
                                                  Category == "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1" & Q_gnomADv2.1.1 == "Fail" ~ "Fail",
                                                  Category == "Unique to gnomADv4.1" & Q_gnomADv4.1 == "Pass" ~ "Pass",
                                                  Category == "Unique to gnomADv4.1" & Q_gnomADv4.1 == "Fail" ~ "Fail", TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
                       filter(Quality != "Other") %>%  
                       filter(Category == "Unique to gnomADv2.1.1" & Quality == "Pass"), by = "ID")

v2_Unique

v2_Unique <- v2_Unique %>% 
             filter(Version == "gnomADv2.1.1" & Region != "Joint" & Quality == "Passed") %>%
             rowwise() %>%
             mutate(FAF95_MAX = max(c(FAF95_AFR, 
                                      FAF95_AMR, 
                                      FAF95_EAS, 
                                      FAF95_NFE, 
                                      FAF95_SAS), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
             mutate(FAF95_MAXETH = {Index <- which(c(FAF95_AFR, 
                                                     FAF95_AMR, 
                                                     FAF95_EAS, 
                                                     FAF95_NFE, 
                                                     FAF95_SAS) == max(c(FAF95_AFR, 
                                                                         FAF95_AMR,
                                                                         FAF95_EAS, 
                                                                         FAF95_NFE, 
                                                                         FAF95_SAS), na.rm = TRUE))
                                    if (length(Index) == 1) {c("AFR", "AMR", "EAS", "NFE", "SAS")[Index]} 
             
                                    # In cases of tied max FAF95, report FAF95 with greatest variant count
                                    else {Index2 <- Index[which(c(Allele.Count_AFR,
                                                                  Allele.Count_AMR, 
                                                                  Allele.Count_EAS, 
                                                                  Allele.Count_NFE, 
                                                                  Allele.Count_SAS)[Index] == max(c(Allele.Count_AFR,
                                                                                                    Allele.Count_AMR,
                                                                                                    Allele.Count_EAS,
                                                                                                    Allele.Count_NFE, 
                                                                                                    Allele.Count_SAS)[Index], na.rm = TRUE))]
                                    if (length(Index2) == 1) {c("AFR", "AMR", "EAS", "NFE", "SAS")[Index2]} 
                                    
                                    # In cases of tied max FAF95 & allele count, report FAF95 with greatest number of alleles tested
                                    else {Max <- max(c(Allele.Total_AFR,
                                                       Allele.Total_AMR, 
                                                       Allele.Total_EAS, 
                                                       Allele.Total_NFE, 
                                                       Allele.Total_SAS)[Index2], na.rm = TRUE)
                                    
                                    c("AFR",
                                      "AMR",
                                      "EAS",
                                      "NFE", 
                                      "SAS")[Index2[which.max(c(Allele.Total_AFR, 
                                                                Allele.Total_AMR, 
                                                                Allele.Total_EAS,
                                                                Allele.Total_NFE,
                                                                Allele.Total_SAS)[Index2])]]}}}) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
         mutate(Count = case_when(FAF95_MAXETH == "AFR" ~ Allele.Count_AFR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "AMR" ~ Allele.Count_AMR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "EAS" ~ Allele.Count_EAS,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "NFE" ~ Allele.Count_NFE,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "SAS" ~ Allele.Count_SAS,
                                  TRUE ~ NA_integer_),
                Total = case_when(FAF95_MAXETH == "AFR" ~ Allele.Total_AFR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "AMR" ~ Allele.Total_AMR,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "EAS" ~ Allele.Total_EAS,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "NFE" ~ Allele.Total_NFE,
                                  FAF95_MAXETH == "SAS" ~ Allele.Total_SAS,
                                  TRUE ~ NA_integer_)) %>%
         group_by(Chromosome, Gene, Start, Ref, Alt) %>%
         mutate(Allele.Frequency_ALL = max(Allele.Frequency_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
                Homozygotes_ALL = max(Homozygotes_ALL, na.rm = TRUE),
                FAF95_MAX = max(FAF95_MAX, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
         slice_max(order_by = FAF95_MAX, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
         ungroup() %>%
         dplyr::select(Chromosome, Gene, Start, End, Ref, Alt, Allele.Frequency_ALL, Homozygotes_ALL, FAF95_MAX, Count, Total, ClinVar, Stars, Quality) %>%
         distinct() %>%
         mutate(BA1 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.005, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # 95% MAX FAF >= 0.005 (0.5%) where allele total >= 2000 & allele count >= 5
                BS1 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.001 & FAF95_MAX < 0.005, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # 95% MAX FAF >= 0.001 (0.1%) where allele total >= 2000 & allele count >= 5 [Exlcudes BA1 range]
                PM2_Supporting = ifelse(Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),        # ALL AF < 0.0001 (0.01%)
                BS2 = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL >= 2, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),                            # 2 >= Homozygotes
                BS2_Supporting = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL == 1, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),                 # 1 == Homozygote
                Conflict_BS2_PM2 = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL >= 2 & Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # Meets both criteria [evidence for benign & pathogenic]
                Conflict_BS1_PM2 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.001 & FAF95_MAX < 0.005 & Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied")) %>%  # Meets both criteria [evidence for benign & pathogenic]
        mutate(ClinVar = ifelse(ClinVar == "Uncertain_significance", "Uncertain significance", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Likely_benign", "Benign/Likely benign", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Benign/Likely_benign", "Benign/Likely benign", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "other", "Uncertain significance", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Likely_pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Benign", "Benign/Likely benign",
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic|other", "Uncertain significance", 
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Conflicting_classifications_of_pathogenicity", "Uncertain significance",
                         ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", NA))))))))))) %>%
        mutate(ID = paste(Chromosome, Start, End, Ref, Alt, sep = "_"))
```

```{r conflictvar}
Conflict <- Data1 %>%

            filter(Conflict_BS2_PM2 == "Satisfied" | Conflict_BS1_PM2 == "Satisfied") %>%
            dplyr::select(-ID, -BA1, -BS2_Supporting, -Homozygotes_ALL, -Count, -Total, -Conflict_BS2_PM2, -Conflict_BS1_PM2, -Stars) %>%
            dplyr::select(Chromosome, Gene, Start, End, Ref, Alt, ClinVar, FAF95_MAX, Allele.Frequency_ALL, BS1, BS2, PM2_Supporting) %>%

         ClinVar = ifelse(is.na(ClinVar), "Not available", ClinVar),
         across(everything(), ~ifelse(.x == "Satisfied", "Met", .x)),
```
