                   BS1 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.001 & FAF95_MAX < 0.005, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # 95% MAX FAF >= 0.001 (0.1%) where allele total >= 2000 & allele count >= 5 [Exlcudes BA1 range]
                   PM2_Supporting = ifelse(Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),        # ALL AF < 0.0001 (0.01%)
                   BS2 = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL >= 2, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),                            # 2 >= Homozygotes
                   BS2_Supporting = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL == 1, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"),                 # 1 == Homozygote
                   Conflict_BS2_PM2 = ifelse(Homozygotes_ALL >= 2 & Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied"), # Meets both criteria [evidence for benign & pathogenic]
                   Conflict_BS1_PM2 = ifelse(Total >= 2000 & Count >= 5 & FAF95_MAX >= 0.001 & FAF95_MAX < 0.005 & Allele.Frequency_ALL < 0.0001, "Satisfied", "Not satisfied")) %>%  # Meets both criteria [evidence for benign & pathogenic]
            mutate(ClinVar = ifelse(ClinVar == "Uncertain_significance", "Uncertain significance", 
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic/Likely_pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", 
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "Likely_benign", "Benign/Likely benign", 
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "Benign/Likely_benign", "Benign/Likely benign", 
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "other", "Uncertain significance", 
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "Likely_pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", 
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "Benign", "Benign/Likely benign",
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic|other", "Uncertain significance", 
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "Conflicting_classifications_of_pathogenicity", "Uncertain significance",
                             ifelse(ClinVar == "Pathogenic", "Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic", NA))))))))))) %>%
            mutate(ID = paste0("Chr",Chromosome,":", Start,"-", End)) %>%
            mutate(ID2 = paste0(ID, "(",Ref, ">", Alt, ")")) %>%
            mutate(BA1_AFR = ifelse(Allele.Total_AFR >= 2000 & Allele.Count_AFR >= 5 & FAF95_AFR >= 0.005, "AFR", "Not satisfied"),
                   BA1_AMR = ifelse(Allele.Total_AMR >= 2000 & Allele.Count_AMR >= 5 & FAF95_AMR >= 0.005, "AMR", "Not satisfied"),
                   BA1_EAS = ifelse(Allele.Total_EAS >= 2000 & Allele.Count_EAS >= 5 & FAF95_EAS >= 0.005, "EAS", "Not satisfied"),
                   BA1_NFE = ifelse(Allele.Total_NFE >= 2000 & Allele.Count_NFE >= 5 & FAF95_NFE >= 0.005, "NFE", "Not satisfied"),
                   BA1_SAS = ifelse(Allele.Total_SAS >= 2000 & Allele.Count_SAS >= 5 & FAF95_SAS >= 0.005, "SAS", "Not satisfied")) %>%
            rowwise() %>%
            mutate(BA1_Populations = {x <- c_across(BA1_AFR:BA1_SAS)
                                     paste(x[!is.na(x) & x != "Not satisfied"], collapse = ", ")}) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            dplyr::select(-c(BA1_AFR:BA1_SAS))  %>%
            dplyr::select(Chromosome, Gene, ID, Ref, Alt, ClinVar, FAF95_MAX, BA1, BA1_Populations) %>% 
            arrange(Chromosome, Gene) %>%
     mutate(ClinVar = ifelse(is.na(ClinVar), "Not available", ClinVar),
            across(everything(), ~ifelse(.x == "Satisfied", "Met", .x)),
            across(everything(), ~ifelse(.x == "Not satisfied", "Not met", .x))) %>%
            dplyr::select(-Chromosome) %>%
            mutate(ID2 = paste0(ID, "(",Ref, ">", Alt, ")"))

BA1_Comparison <- full_join(DataBA1 %>%
                            mutate(Present_v4 = TRUE) %>%
                            dplyr::select(Gene, ID, ID2, Ref, Alt, ClinVar, BA1, FAF95_MAX, BA1_Populations, Present_v4),
                            DataBA12 %>%
                            mutate(Present_v2 = TRUE) %>%
                            dplyr::select(Gene, ID, ID2, Ref, Alt, ClinVar, BA1, FAF95_MAX, BA1_Populations, Present_v2),
                            by = c("Gene", "ID2"), suffix = c("_v4", "_v2")) %>%
  
                  # Retain variants meeting BA1 in either version
                  filter(BA1_v4 %in% "Met" | BA1_v2 %in% "Met") %>%
  
                  # Distinguish variants not found from those not meeting BA1
                  mutate(BA1_v4 = ifelse(is.na(Present_v4), "Not found", BA1_v4),
                         BA1_v2 = ifelse(is.na(Present_v2), "Not found", BA1_v2),
                         
                         # Identify which version(s) meet BA1
                         BA1_Version = case_when(BA1_v4 == "Met" & BA1_v2 == "Met" ~ "Both versions",
                                                 BA1_v4 == "Met" ~ "gnomADv4.1",
                                                 BA1_v2 == "Met" ~ "gnomADv2.1.1")) %>%
                  mutate(ClinVar_v4 = coalesce(na_if(ClinVar_v4, "Not available"),
                                               na_if(ClinVar_v2, "Not available"),
                                               "Not available")) %>%
                  filter(BA1_v2 != "Not found" & BA1_v4 != "Not found") %>%
                  dplyr::select(Gene, ID_v4, Ref_v4, Alt_v4, ClinVar_v4, BA1_Version, BA1_Populations_v4, BA1_Populations_v2) %>%
                  arrange(Gene, ID_v4) %>%
                  mutate(BA1_Populations_v4 = ifelse(BA1_Populations_v4 == "", "Not applicable", BA1_Populations_v4),
                         BA1_Populations_v2 = ifelse(BA1_Populations_v2 == "", "Not applicable", BA1_Populations_v2))
